sents.zh: 我有三个非常好的朋友。
sents.en: I have three very good friends.

sents.zh: 我们在一个学校，也在一个班。
sents.en: We are at the same school and in the same class.

sents.zh: 每天中午，我们四个人一起吃饭。
sents.en: Every day at noon the four of us eat together.

sents.zh: 下课以后，我们也常常一起玩。
sents.en: After class we often play together too.

sents.zh: 有的时候我们的想法不一样。
sents.en: Sometimes we do not think the same way.

sents.zh: 不过说一说，很快就好了。
sents.en: But after talking it over, it is soon fine again.

sents.zh: 上个月，我生病了，不能去学校。
sents.en: Last month I fell ill and could not go to school.

sents.zh: 我一个人在家，觉得很没有意思。
sents.en: I was at home alone, and it felt very dull.

sents.zh: 第三天，他们三个人来看我。
sents.en: On the third day the three of them came to see me.

sents.zh: 他们带来了水果，还有两本书。
sents.en: They brought fruit, and two books.

sents.zh: 他们坐在我的床边，说学校里的事情。
sents.en: They sat by my bed and talked about what was happening at school.

sents.zh: 我听了以后很高兴，一下子忘了自己生病。
sents.en: Hearing it made me happy, and I forgot at once that I was ill.

sents.zh: 他们走的时候说：“你快点好起来。”
sents.en: As they left they said: "Get well soon."

sents.zh: 第二天早上，我就觉得好多了。
sents.en: By the next morning I already felt much better.

sents.zh: 我想，好朋友真的可以让人好起来。
sents.en: I think good friends really can make a person well.
